title: CRT DREAM — The Warm Light of 2003
description: Retro CRT nostalgia — a warm amber phosphor tube. Scanlines drift down the glass, the corners darken with barrel vignette, and the wordmark glows fuzzy like a monitor left on at 3 AM. The soft, fuzzy warmth of a screen that never quite rendered a straight line.
